description: MUST-NORMALIZE (issue #563, supersedes issue #199's fail-closed rule for this fixture): the paragraph carries TWO pending (unresolved) tracked-change revisions from two DIFFERENT authors -- multiple revision authors interleaved on the same clause text. Prior to issue #563 this was reserved fail-closed as genuinely ambiguous; #563 found that reasoning did not hold in the real pipeline (every cluster's resulting_text is the SAME whole-paragraph accept-all text, per `_build_paragraph_record`, which computes it once for the whole paragraph and stamps the identical value onto every cluster's revision record) and redefined this as ACCEPT-ALL with a disclosure note naming the cluster/author counts, same as a single-author pending revision. Both revision records below carry the SAME resulting_text, faithful to how the real extractor emits multi-author clusters. Only a malformed (no resulting_text) record still fails closed.
